items.description: Overide (pronounced over·ide) is a lightweight, yet powerful CLI tool that seamlessly integrates AI-powered code generation into your development workflow. It works platform-agnostically with OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Groq to provide intelligent code updates directly in your preferred code editor - no extensions required.

items.name: replicate-flux-mcp

items.name: refakts
items.description: RefakTS is a TypeScript refactoring tool built by AI coding agents for AI coding agents. It allows them to perform precise refactoring operations via command line instead of error prone text generation.

items.name: use-kimi-on-cursor
items.description: Open-source bridge to use Kimi AI inside Cursor. Connect Kimi models to your AI coding workflow with fast setup, clean configuration, and reliable local tooling for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and agentic development.

items.name: OpenCodeRAG
items.description: OpenCodeRAG is a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) plugin for semantic code search powered by locally-hosted embedding models. It features a seamless integration with OpenCode and other AI tools via MCP and offers a CLI interface for external usage. It offers hybrid search, image description, persistent memory and local decision model usage.

items.name: zig-mcp-server
items.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides Zig language tooling, code analysis, and documentation access. This server enhances AI capabilities with Zig-specific functionality including code optimization, compute unit estimation, code generation, and best practices recommendations.
